scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix client run test --if-present && npm --prefix server run test --if-present
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
